title: 马克·吕特宣布下次北大西洋公约组织峰会选址阿尔巴尼亚
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A summit next year in Albania, if not when.
segments.zh: 明年在阿尔巴尼亚举行的峰会，如果不是现在的话。

segments.en: Thank you. The next summit will indeed be in Albania.
segments.zh: 谢谢。下一次峰会确实将在阿尔巴尼亚举行。

segments.en: That was the decision in Dihaic, so the summit now in Ankara.
segments.zh: 这是在迪哈伊克做出的决定，所以现在峰会在安卡拉举行。

segments.en: And then the next summit in Albania. So from now on, of course, the next summit is not in Ankara, because we are in Ankara now.
segments.zh: 然后下一次峰会在阿尔巴尼亚。从现在起，下一次峰会当然不在安卡拉，因为我们现在就在安卡拉。

segments.en: So the next summit is in Albania. And of course, we still have to decide on the exact timing.
segments.zh: 所以下一次峰会在阿尔巴尼亚。当然，我们还需要确定具体时间。
